title: coordkit agent definition
description: Logical definition of one coordinated agent role. The runtime currently loads these from Markdown frontmatter, but the schema names the contract so agent discovery is not only an implementation detail.

name.description: Stable agent name used for routing and display.

description.description: Short human-readable summary of the agent's purpose.

role_type.description: Whether the agent participates in workflow orchestration or system diagnosis.

lifecycle_stage.description: Workflow stage where the agent is relevant.

routing_keywords.description: Terms used to match a task to the agent.

tools.description: Optional tool access declaration for the host runtime.

color.description: Optional UI color hint for the agent.
